modules.activity: Create a prompt agent, observe the no-tools baseline and native tracing.
modules.after_tf: Create/version the real agent in an existing team project; verify tracing.

modules.activity: Import REST, expose MCP and connect governed documentation tools; the toolkit is first discovered in M4.
modules.after_tf: Build participant-prefixed authenticated APIs/MCP/connections; the working reference is an explicit catch-up option, not the primary exercise.

modules.activity: Observe gateway attribution, request/token limits and actual 429 responses.
modules.after_tf: Invoke real governed routes; edit team-prefixed exercise policies, not Terraform-owned reference resources.

modules.activity: Register, describe, discover and reuse APIs/MCP tools in API Center.
modules.after_tf: Create team-prefixed catalog metadata/registrations and export actual definitions; validate client interoperability.

modules.activity: Compare two model deployments by two prompt variants with quality, latency, tokens and cost.
modules.after_tf: Bind four real immutable agent variants, register/verify evaluations, invoke fresh and verify provenance.

modules.activity: Compare grounded retrieval with and without the real Search knowledge connection.
modules.after_tf: Explicit initialization runs real indexers and creates knowledge objects/connections; then attach retrieval to an agent.
modules.extra_infrastructure: Search/model prerequisites already selected by this scenario

modules.activity: Build/deploy an additional independent MCP application, govern it and register it.
modules.after_tf: Build/push a new image and deploy an extra ACA app using the precreated extension group, pull identity and environment; add APIM/API Center objects.
modules.extra_infrastructure: YES: participant-created ACA application and image; no new shared service required

modules.activity: Implement writer/reviewer workflow with trace-visible routing and human approval.
modules.after_tf: Create two agents and assemble/test the actual workflow; prompts alone are not runnable orchestration.
modules.extra_infrastructure: none; local coordinator or supported Foundry workflow

modules.activity: Exercise model backend pool/circuit breaker, Content Safety and optional semantic cache.
modules.after_tf: Configure/test team exercise policies. Cache requires explicit initial workload selection or a later reviewed TF update.
modules.extra_infrastructure: Redis only if selected; existing two deployments are NOT regional failover

modules.activity: Attribute actual usage to authenticated callers/teams and calculate estimated cost.
modules.after_tf: Add/verify caller dimensions and price actual model/token meters; missing telemetry or prices must not become zero cost.

modules.activity: Run evaluation-gated CI and a reviewed Terraform plan with OIDC/remote state.
modules.after_tf: During Module 0, select the real repository/protected environment, apply the separate native delivery stage, migrate applied foundation state and verify a genuine gated CI run.
modules.extra_infrastructure: YES: separate native delivery stage for OIDC identity/scoped grants/protected state; not automatically applied by foundation/access/workload

modules.activity: Extend core approved proposal saving, test refusal/approval and separate librarian publication.
modules.after_tf: Use real approval-driven writes and separate human-only publication. Do not defer core save approval until this bonus.

modules.activity: Use authenticated MCP from a coding agent, with a REST/CLI alternative.
modules.after_tf: Export real endpoint configuration; participant supplies short-lived Entra authentication. A coding-agent subscription is optional, not a core dependency.

modules.activity: Build a small local frontend against genuine Foundry and governed proposal endpoints.
modules.after_tf: Participant builds/runs a local server-side authenticated client bound to a real agent/version; no prebuilt solution.
modules.extra_infrastructure: none for local-only; cloud hosting is outside the initial selection
